summary.what_it_does: Rukovoditel is described as an open-source web application designer for business, meant to be installed on a local or internet web server. It is a PHP web application requiring PHP 8.0.2 or higher. The page states that the main version is free and fully functional without restrictions. It is licensed under GNU GPLv3. The awesome-selfhosted listing categorises it under project management and describes it as a configurable, web-based open source project management application.
notable: Configurable web application designer for business
Main version is free and fully functional without restrictions
caveats: Requires a web server with PHP 8.0.2 or higher, so it needs self-hosting setup
The page does not describe paid tiers or any features beyond the free main version
